FX-NEUTRAL-001.says: The settings as they start, black, grey and white to neutralize and nothing added: the drawing, untouched.

FX-NEUTRAL-002.says: Shadows unbalance the warm shadow #3c2d1e: its cast, turned the other way, is added in full at black and fades out toward the midtones; the warm shadow itself, under a fifth of the way up, loses about two thirds of its cast, its lightness kept; middle grey and up are untouched.

FX-NEUTRAL-003.says: Midtones unbalance the warm midtone #968064: the cast taken out most at middle lightness, fading to nothing at black and at white.

FX-NEUTRAL-004.says: Highlights unbalance the warm highlight #f0e6c8: the cast taken out of the light colours, white itself turned bluish.

FX-NEUTRAL-005.says: All three: the warm shadow, midtone and highlight themselves (row 0) come out near grey, the cast gone, their lightness kept; their darker copies further down, whose cast is smaller than the correction at their lightness, are pushed past grey toward blue.

FX-NEUTRAL-006.says: Numbers only: shadows red 20 and blue -20, midtones green 10, highlights red -30 and blue 30, levels added and faded between.

FX-NEUTRAL-007.says: All three colours with pinning 50: black and white are pinned, and the correction comes in over the first and last quarter of the way.

FX-NEUTRAL-008.says: Pinning 100: only middle lightness gets the whole correction; the rest less, the nearer black or white.

FX-NEUTRAL-009.says: Black point 40 and white point 200 with all three colours: everything below 40 counts as shadow and above 200 as highlight.

FX-NEUTRAL-010.says: Black point 120 and white point 100, white not above black, with the numbers: lightness below 120 takes the shadows' numbers only, from 120 up the highlights' only.

FX-NEUTRAL-011.says: Pinning keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, all three colours: frame 0 is FX-NEUTRAL-005, frame 2 pinning 50, FX-NEUTRAL-007, frame 4 FX-NEUTRAL-008.
